full_prompt_en: A square naturalistic wildlife painting shows a pale heron standing at the right edge of a dark pond covered with lily pads. The setting is dense with layered green foliage, and the upper background dissolves into cool gray-green mist beneath overhanging leaves. Fern-like fronds, broad leaves, thin stems, and fine grasses occupy the back bank, their different shapes overlapping without forming a clear horizon. The bird stands slightly right of center on a small patch of low plants. Its long slim legs are partly hidden among leaves, and its body turns toward the left. A gently curved neck carries a small head and a long yellowish pointed beak angled down toward the water. Cream-white feathers along the neck and wing catch the brightest soft light; fine gray strokes indicate individual feather layers across the folded body. Darker shadow gathers under the wing and behind the legs, separating the bird from the foliage without a hard outline. The pond fills the lower half, its nearly black-green water dotted with broad, flat lily pads in olive, sage, and muted brown. Some pads overlap, and small red-brown floating marks break the green rhythm. Near the lower left, one small white flower rises above the pads and gives the foreground a second pale accent. A narrow open patch of water leads back toward the bird, creating a quiet line of attention from the flower to its lowered beak. The light is diffuse, as if filtered through cloud and foliage, with gentle highlights on feathers and pad rims and no sharp cast shadow. The painted surface is detailed but softened by humid atmosphere: nearby leaves and feathers have precise edges, while the distant thicket blurs into layered tones. No human structures or readable text appear. The overall composition is still and secluded, balancing the bright, delicate bird and flower against a broad, richly varied field of dark green water and vegetation.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形写实野生动物绘画呈现一只浅色鹭鸟，站在铺满睡莲叶的深色池塘右岸。环境里层叠绿叶十分茂密，上部背景在低垂叶片下融入冷灰绿色薄雾。蕨类般叶片、宽叶、细茎和纤草占据后方池岸，各种形态互相重叠，没有形成清楚地平线。鸟站在中央略右的一小片低矮植物上。修长双腿部分藏在叶间，身体转向左侧。轻弯的颈托着小小的头，长而偏黄的尖喙向下指向水面。颈部和翅上的奶油白羽毛接住最明亮的柔光；细灰笔触标出折起身体上的层层羽片。较深阴影聚于翼下和腿后，在没有坚硬勾线的情况下把鸟从叶丛中分开。池塘填满下半部，近黑绿色水面点缀着宽阔平坦的睡莲叶，叶色为橄榄、鼠尾草绿与低调褐色。部分叶片互相遮叠，细小红褐浮痕打断绿色节奏。靠近左下，一朵小白花升在叶片上方，为前景提供第二处浅色重音。一条狭窄开阔水面向后通往鸟，让视线从花朵安静地走向低垂的鸟喙。光线漫射，仿佛经过云层和叶丛过滤，只在羽毛和叶缘留下轻柔高光，没有锐利投影。绘画表面细致，却被潮湿空气柔化：近处叶片和羽毛边缘精确，远处密林则模糊成层叠调子。画中没有人造结构或可读文字。整体构图静止而隐蔽，以明亮纤巧的鸟与花朵平衡宽阔且变化丰富的深绿水面和植物。
style_prompt_en: The naturalistic painting builds a secluded atmosphere through layered botanical-looking marks, dark reflective areas, and selective pale highlights. Deep olive, moss green, sage, and cool gray create a restrained near-analogous palette, with small cream-white accents carrying the strongest contrast. Fine, precise strokes describe textured surfaces near the focal zone; farther layers lose edge clarity in humid gray-green haze. Broad flat rounded shapes alternate with thin vertical stems and softer irregular masses, giving the composition a measured organic rhythm. Diffuse light filters through the scene without a strong cast shadow, so volume emerges from subtle changes in value and overlap. Dark open patches prevent the dense texture from becoming uniformly busy. The surface retains painterly softness while preserving delicate local detail. The overall effect is quiet and observant, with tonal restraint and atmospheric depth making small light forms feel especially luminous.
style_prompt_zh: 写实绘画借层叠的植物般痕迹、深色反光区域和有选择的浅色高光建立隐蔽气氛。深橄榄、苔绿、鼠尾草绿和冷灰形成克制的近似色域，小面积奶油白重音承担最强反差。视觉焦点附近用细密精确笔触描绘有肌理的表面，远处层次则在潮湿灰绿雾气中失去边缘清晰度。宽阔平坦的圆形与细竖线、柔软不规则团块交替，赋予构图有节制的有机节奏。漫射光经过场景过滤，没有强烈投影，体积由微妙明度变化及重叠显出。深色开放区域让密集肌理不至于处处同样繁忙。表面保留绘画的柔软，同时维护局部精细细节。整体效果安静而富于观察感，调性克制与大气深度使细小浅色形体显得格外明亮。
theme_en: A white heron beside a quiet lily-covered pond
theme_zh: 白鹭立于铺满睡莲的安静池塘边
name: Robert Bateman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
